description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a login and registration screen. It manages user input, validation, and interacts with an authentication provider to log in or register users, providing appropriate UI feedback.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a login/signup form interface.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the form logic, validation, loading state, and user interaction for LoginScreen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the login/register form with input fields, buttons, and logic for switching between login and registration modes.
